play.description: Play an audio URL, a radio or a file

radio.description: Listen to a built-in web radio (no argument: the list)

options.next: Play right after the current track

options.to: Jump straight to this queue position

clear.details: {count} track(s) removed. The current track keeps playing.

radio.listHelp: {count} free public radios. Start one with `/radio station:` (autocomplete searches by name or genre).

pause.hint: Use `/resume` or the Resume button to continue.

skip.end: {skipped} was skipped. The queue is over.

stop.details: The queue was cleared ({count} track(s) removed).

join.details: I am in {channel}. Start some music with `/play` or `/radio`.

player.leftIdle: No music for 2 minutes, so I left the voice channel. Turn on 24/7 mode with `/music config` to keep me there.
player.leftAlone: Nobody had been listening for 2 minutes, so I left the voice channel.

config.title: Music settings
config.footer: Members with Manage Server always have DJ rights.

errors.title: Music
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.discordPermissions: Discord refused the action: I am missing a permission in this channel.
errors.unavailable: The music module is disabled on this bot (voice dependencies missing).
errors.sameChannel: You must be in my voice channel ({channel}) to control the music.
errors.notConnected: I am not connected to any voice channel.
errors.djOnly: This action is reserved for the {role} role or members who can manage the server.
errors.manageGuild: You need the Manage Server permission to change the music settings.
errors.connectFailed: I could not connect to the voice channel. Try again in a moment.
errors.playUsage: Give a song name, an audio URL (`url:`) or attach a file (`file:`). For the built-in radios, use `/radio`.
errors.notUrl: I could not find anything for that. Try a different song name or a direct audio link.
errors.protocol: Only http and https URLs are accepted.
errors.blocked: This address is not allowed (local or private network).
errors.dns: This domain name could not be found.
errors.network: The audio server is not responding properly ({reason}).
errors.timeout: The audio server took too long to answer.
errors.http: The audio server answered with HTTP error {status}.
errors.redirects: Too many redirects for this URL.
errors.notAudio: This link does not point to audio (received type: {type}). It must be a direct link to a file or stream, not a web page.
errors.notAudioFile: The file {name} is not an audio file.
errors.filesDisabled: Playing attached files is disabled on this server.
errors.hls: HLS streams (m3u8 split into segments) are not supported. Use the radio's direct MP3 or AAC URL.
errors.emptyPlaylist: This playlist contains no playable link.
errors.decode: The audio could not be decoded (unsupported format or empty stream).
errors.tooManyFailures: Several tracks in a row could not be played, so the queue was stopped.
errors.radioNotFound: No radio matches "{query}". Type `/radio` without argument to see the list.
errors.queueFull: The queue is full ({max} tracks maximum).
errors.queueEmpty: There are no upcoming tracks in the queue.
errors.queueTooShort: At least 2 upcoming tracks are needed to shuffle.
errors.badPosition: Invalid position. The queue has {max} upcoming track(s).
errors.seekLive: You cannot seek in a live stream.
errors.seekBeyond: This position is past the end of the track ({duration}).
errors.noResults: No song found for that search. Try different words or a direct audio link.
errors.searchFailed: YouTube search is unavailable right now. Try again later or use a direct audio link.

controls.title: Music control
controls.description: Who can drive the music and how it is played.

presence.title: Presence and announcements
presence.description: How the bot behaves in the voice channel and the "now playing" messages.

djRole.label: DJ role
djRole.help: Reserved to this role: skip, stop, loop, volume, seek and queue edits. Empty: everyone in the voice channel can.

maxQueue.label: Maximum queue size
maxQueue.help: Maximum number of waiting tracks (1 to 1000).

defaultVolume.label: Default volume (%)
defaultVolume.help: Volume used when the bot joins a channel (0 to 150).

allowFiles.label: Allow attached files
allowFiles.help: Allows `/play file:` with an audio file uploaded to Discord.

stay247.label: 24/7 mode
stay247.help: The bot stays in the channel even alone or without music, and resumes the radio after a restart.

announce.label: Announce every track
announce.help: Posts a "now playing" message with buttons for every new track.

announceChannel.label: Announcement channel
announceChannel.help: Empty: announcements go to the channel where the track was requested.

actions.unavailable: The music module is disabled (voice dependencies missing).

disconnect.label: Stop the music and disconnect the bot
disconnect.done: Music stopped, bot disconnected from voice.
disconnect.notConnected: The bot is not connected to any voice channel on this server.

console.disabled: Music module disabled: the dependency "{dependency}" could not be loaded ({reason}). Run "npm install" to install the optional dependencies (@discordjs/voice, prism-media, ffmpeg-static). The rest of the bot works normally.
console.noVoiceIntent: Music module: the GuildVoiceStates intent is not enabled, so the bot cannot see who is in voice channels and music will not work.
